hint.words: One or more words separated by a vertical bar.
hint.launchbox: Enter the platform name as you want it to appear in LaunchBox
hint.media_folder: Select the output folder where the media should be generated
hint.compact_xml: Decrease the gamelist file by removing unnecessary characters (spaces, carriage returns, ...)
hint.articles: Move language depending articles to the end of name: "The Haunted House" becomes "Haunted House, The"
hint.filename: Replace the scraped gamename with the undecorated filename (w/o everything in () or [])
hint.filename_marks: Append everything between () or [] from the filename to the final game name
hint.deduplicate: Allow similar image to be saved once and linked as many times as required in game list. May save some disk space.
hint.move_left: Move the selected media one position toward the beginning of the list.
hint.move_right: Move the selected media one position toward the end of the list.
hint.add_media: Add a media type to download or generate.
hint.override: Use this system's own settings for this section instead of the shared settings.
hint.frontend: Select the frontend that will use the game list.
hint.kill_frontend: Stop the frontend before writing the game list. Recalbox and RetroPie use SSH.
hint.secondary: Additional ScreenScraper system IDs, separated by commas, to search for this platform's games.
hint.platform: Select the ScreenScraper system to search for these games.
hint.list_format: The game list format must be supported by the selected frontend.
hint.list_behavior: Choose how to handle an existing game list: preserve, update or recreate it.
hint.list_file: Path to the output game list XML file.
hint.folders: Choose how subfolders are included in the EmulationStation game list.
hint.favorite_rating: Mark games as favorites when their rating exceeds the selected threshold.
hint.favorite_words: Mark a game as a favorite if its name contains any of the specified words.
hint.favorite_staff: Mark games recommended by the ScreenScraper team as favorites.
hint.hide_unscraped: Mark games not found in the database as hidden; ROM files remain on disk.
hint.hide_words: Hide games whose names contain any specified word, keeping their game list entries.
hint.hide_extensions: Hide games with the specified file extensions, keeping their game list entries.
hint.exclude_unscraped: Exclude games not found in the database from the game list. ROM files are not deleted.
hint.exclude_words: Exclude games whose names contain any specified word from the list. ROM files are kept.
hint.hide_category: Mark games in this category as hidden, keeping them in the list and on disk.
hint.exclude_category: Exclude games in this category from the list, keeping their ROM files on disk.
hint.hide_regions: Hide games whose regions are outside the specified list.
hint.exclude_regions: Exclude games whose regions are outside the specified list.
hint.case_original: Keep the letter case of the text received from the database.
hint.filename_region: Detect the region from tags in the ROM filename.
hint.no_synopsis: Do not write the game description to the game list.
hint.decoration: Append this database tag to the game name when available, unless filename tags are being preserved.
hint.copy_main: Replace this system's media settings with a copy of the shared settings.
hint.refresh_preview: Refresh the preview of the selected media.
hint.media_type: Choose what to download or generate: an image, MIX, video, document or another media type.
hint.internal_mix: Select a built-in template combining several game images.
hint.image_type: Choose a ScreenScraper image type, such as a cover, screenshot or logo.
hint.link_media: Write a link to the saved media in the corresponding game list field.
hint.no_link_media: Save media files without adding links to them in the game list.
hint.cleanup_media: After successful scraping, remove obsolete media previously created by this application from the output folder.
hint.resize_width: Resize generated images to the specified width in pixels.
hint.resize_height: Resize generated images to the specified height in pixels.
hint.keep_ratio: Preserve the image aspect ratio when resizing.
hint.method: Choose how ROMs are identified: by filename or by calculating checksums.
hint.rom_region: Prefer the ROM region when choosing data and media, then use the configured priorities.
hint.strict_region: Use only the specified regions without falling back to data from other regions.
hint.classification: Select an age rating system, such as PEGI or ESRB.
hint.logs: Save the scraping run log to a file.
hint.verbose: Include detailed diagnostic messages in the log.
hint.missing: Save a list of ROMs not found in the database, including their checksums.
hint.retries: Number of HTTP request retries after a connection error.
hint.ttl: Number of days cached database responses remain valid before being requested again.
hint.reuse: Reuse previously saved media. Requires an enabled cache.
hint.cache_folder: Folder for cached responses and media. An empty path disables caching.
hint.cache_limit: Maximum cache size in GB. The oldest entries are removed when the limit is exceeded.
hint.anonymous: Access ScreenScraper without a personal account, subject to anonymous access limits.
hint.ui_language: Application interface language; does not change the language of downloaded game descriptions.
hint.stop: Stop the current scraping run after the operation in progress completes.
hint.start: Start scraping the checked systems using the current settings.
hint.only_new: Process only games not yet present in the existing game list.
hint.scope: Select shared settings or settings for a specific system.
hint.inspector_global: Use shared settings for all sections of the selected system.
hint.reveal_password: Show or hide the entered password.
hint.detect: Detect platforms from folder names inside the selected ROM folder.
hint.recursive: Search for platform folders at every nesting level.
hint.aliases: Include additional platform name variants when recognizing folders.
hint.offline: Complete setup without checking the ScreenScraper connection.
hint.developer: ScreenScraper application ID. Change only when using your own API credentials.
hint.developer_password: ScreenScraper application password matching the application ID.
hint.field_help: Show the field description, format and accepted values.
hint.clear_media: Remove the media reference from the game being edited.
hint.replace_media: Select a local media file for this game.
hint.return_library: Return to the library after scraping finishes.
hint.ko_quota: Failed lookups today / ScreenScraper daily limit. KO means that the ROM or game was not found. Different search methods for one game can produce multiple KO requests. Cached misses do not consume quota. When the limit is reached, the server returns HTTP 431.
Lookup miss: %s — %s; no ROM/game matche: Lookup miss: %s — %s; no ROM/game matched the supplied platform and identification.
No games need updating; existing gamelis: No games need updating; existing gamelist preserved.
Only new: %d new games, %d already liste: Only new: %d new games, %d already listed.
hint.resume_scraping: Resume the stopped run with the remaining games. Completed games and their results are retained. After a quota stop, wait until the quota is available again. Resume is available until a new run starts or the application closes.
Scraping resumed; completed games will b: Scraping resumed; completed games will be skipped.
